visualCharacteristics: A tabbed interface presented inside a white rounded card panel over a colored background. A horizontal row of tab labels sits above a content panel that swaps as tabs are selected. Panels contain feature grids, CTAs, and promo cards.
contentPattern: Tabs: one row per tab with two columns — the first cell is the tab label, the second cell is that tab's panel content.
usage: A benefits/overview section that organizes rich content (feature grids, CTAs, promo cards) into switchable tabs within a card panel.
